decisions.reason: Assigning the Business category to Article 3 does not change the required author identity, photo source, or placement after the category label.
The Article 3 category mapping does not change the required shape or size of author photos.
The source assigns a category to Made in the USA and does not alter the separate color restriction for the Dorian Vale article.
Specifying Article 3's category does not change the requirement to source article content from the Civic Lantern website.
The category mapping supplies article metadata but does not modify the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The Article 3 category assignment does not change the digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The source contains no change to image-quality enhancement or AI-based image processing.
The Article 3 category mapping neither changes the deferred print-ready deliverable nor its resolution or prepress settings.
